snippet.title: Into The Unwell - Reveal Trailer - Summer Game Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Join the official Into The Unwell Discord: http://discord.gg/intotheunwell
Wishlist and sign-up for the Closed Beta: http://s.team/a/2024600/

Dive into The Unwell as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits in this delightfully despondent third-person action roguelite game, playing alone or with up to two friends!

Find us on
Website: https://shewassuchagoodhorse.com/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/shewassuchagoodhorse.com
https://www.instagram.com/suchagoodhorse
https://www.facebook.com/SheWasSuchAGoodHorse/
https://www.tiktok.com/@suchagoodhorse

Into The Unwell is developed by She Was Such A Good Horse, published by Coffee Stain Publishing.
